name: VoiceChannelLog
author: Bluscream (bluscream_)
short: Logs voice joins, leaves, moves, mutes, cameras and streams to voice chats or a dedicated log channel.
description: Port and expansion of the Equicord voiceChannelLog plugin. Posts connect/disconnect/move, self and server mute/deafen, camera and stream events into voice text chats or a dedicated log channel with multiple compact display modes (small subtext, normal, embed-small, embed), zero user pings, per-event toggles, and custom templates.
install_msg: Thanks for installing VoiceChannelLog! Run `[p]vclog enable` in your server, then `[p]vclog settings` to see the events and templates.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no personal data. It only keeps per-server settings (enabled events, message templates and ignored channels).
